<script>(() => {
  // src/js/components/mini-cart.js
  function miniCart() {
    return {
      open: false,
      toggle() {
        this.open = !this.open;
      },
      close() {
        this.open = false;
      },
      init() {
        document.addEventListener("cart.updated", () => {
          this.open = true;
        });
      }
    };
  }

  // src/js/components/product-gallery.js
  function productGallery() {
    return {
      current: null,
      index: 0,
      init() {
        const first = this.$el.querySelector("[data-image]");
        this.current = first ? first.dataset.image : null;
      },
      select(src, index = 0) {
        this.current = src;
        this.index = index;
      }
    };
  }

  // src/js/main.js
  document.addEventListener("alpine:init", () => {
    window.Alpine.data("miniCart", miniCart);
    window.Alpine.data("productGallery", productGallery);
  });
})();</script>
